sources.organization_name: EUMETNET MeteoAlarm and participating national services
sources.expected_freshness: Public Atom syndication of active national warnings; CAP issue, effective, onset and expiry times remain distinct.
sources.attribution_guidance: Attribute each warning to MeteoAlarm and the issuing national meteorological service.
limitations: Only explicitly configured participating-country feeds are queried.
Language and warning coverage vary by issuing national service.
Warnings are separate authority artifacts and do not establish a physical incident or impact.

sources.jurisdiction: NOAA tsunami warning centers' areas of responsibility
sources.expected_freshness: Official warning-center Atom feeds; each CAP-TSU message retains source lifecycle and validity times.
sources.attribution_guidance: Attribute warning messages to the named NOAA tsunami warning center and preserve CAP-TSU profile metadata.
limitations: Feed scope follows NOAA warning-center responsibilities and is not evidence of global tsunami occurrence.
A CAP XML signature is shown as present but not verified unless cryptographic verification succeeds.
Warnings are not physical tsunami observations.
sources.provider_registration_name: NOAA U.S. Tsunami Warning System CAP-TSU
